errors.text_span: has tick labels at intervals of 75k
errors.evidence: This phrasing is ambiguous and misleading. The tick labels are not at regular intervals starting from an origin (e.g., 75k, 150k, 225k). The specific labels shown are 100k, 175k, and 250k. While the difference between these specific labels is 75k, stating they are 'at intervals of 75k' misrepresents the structure of the axis.
The final data point for the blue line ('universal' tokenizer) at 250k on the x-axis corresponds to a y-value of approximately 41.9%, not 41.8%. The value 41.8% is a noticeable underestimation.
